projectExperience.title: GuardianSAR — SAR Image Intelligence and Classification
projectExperience.meta: Python | pandas | Pillow | NumPy | Jupyter | PyTorch | matplotlib | Streamlit
projectExperience.text: Developing an explainable and reproducible computer-vision pipeline around the public MSTAR Synthetic Aperture Radar dataset, covering 5,744 grayscale images across 11 classes and separate training and testing splits.
highlights: Created an image-metadata pipeline covering every dataset file and recording its class, split, filename, extension, dimensions, and image mode.
Validated dataset structure for missing metadata and duplicate image identities, then exported a reusable processed metadata CSV.
Analysed class distribution, identified moderate class imbalance, and discovered class-linked native image dimensions that could introduce shortcut-learning risks.
Next phase: standardise resizing and normalisation, create PyTorch Dataset and DataLoader components, and train a baseline CNN classifier.
Planned evaluation includes per-class metrics, a confusion matrix, degraded-image robustness testing, and a minimal analyst-facing Streamlit interface.
